library(RColorBrewer)

Read in atlas

atlas <- readRDS("C:/Users/cat14/OneDrive - Johns Hopkins/Farber_Lab/Basecaller contents/atlas_paper/260212_WT_atlas_v2_cell_cycle.rds")

Calculate proportions of cell cycle phases

cell_cycle_data_phase_cell_type_2_time <- atlas@meta.data %>% group_by(short_cell_type_cluster, Cell_cycle_phase, condition) %>% 
  summarise(Count = n())
`summarise()` has regrouped the output.
ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by short_cell_type_cluster, Cell_cycle_phase, and condition.
ℹ Output is grouped by short_cell_type_cluster and Cell_cycle_phase.
ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(short_cell_type_cluster, Cell_cycle_phase, condition))` for ]8;;ide:help:dplyr::dplyr_byper-operation]8;;
  ]8;;ide:help:dplyr::dplyr_bygrouping]8;; instead.
lvls <- unique(cell_cycle_data_phase_cell_type_2_time$short_cell_type_cluster)
cell_cycle_data_phase_cell_type_2_time$short_cell_type_cluster <- factor(cell_cycle_data_phase_cell_type_2_time$short_cell_type_cluster, levels = lvls)
cell_cycle_data_phase_cell_type_2_time <- mutate(cell_cycle_data_phase_cell_type_2_time, Cond = case_when(
  condition == "t0_UF" ~ "Unfed",
  condition == "t1_15HF" ~ "15min",
  condition == "t2_30HF" ~ "30min",
  condition == "t3_60HF" ~ "1h",
  condition == "t4_120HF" ~ "2h",
  condition == "t5_240HF" ~ "4h"
))
cell_cycle_data_phase_cell_type_2_time$Cond <- factor(cell_cycle_data_phase_cell_type_2_time$Cond, levels = c("Unfed", "15min", "30min", "1h", "2h", "4h"))

Plot it

cell_cycle_by_cell_type_2_time <- ggplot(cell_cycle_data_phase_cell_type_2_time, aes(x = short_cell_type_cluster, y = Count, fill = Cell_cycle_phase)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "identity") + 
  labs(x = "Cell Type", y = "Proportion of Cells", fill = "Cell Cycle\nPhase") +
  facet_wrap(~Cond, ncol = 6) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("#fb9a99", "#1f78b4", "#33a02c")) +
  coord_flip() + scale_x_discrete(breaks = lvls[seq(1, length(lvls), by = 2)]) +
  theme_minimal()  + theme(legend.position = "left", text = element_text(family = "sans", size = 14), legend.key.size = unit(0.125, "in"), strip.text = element_text(size = 12), panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c(0, 0.5, 1))
cell_cycle_by_cell_type_2_time

save_plot("260623_full_cluster_by_cycling_barplot_2x.png", cell_cycle_by_cell_type_2_time, base_height = 20, base_width = 6)
save_plot("260623_full_cluster_by_cycling_barplot_2x.svg", cell_cycle_by_cell_type_2_time, base_height = 20, base_width = 6)

Read in significant results

cell_cycle_propeller <- read_csv("C:/Users/cat14/OneDrive - Johns Hopkins/Farber_Lab/Basecaller contents/atlas_paper/260212_Cell_cycle_proportions_by_cluster_propeller_results.csv")
Rows: 737 Columns: 12
── Column specification ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","
chr  (2): Phase, cluster
dbl (10): BaselineProp, PropMean.t0_UF, PropMean.t1_15HF, PropMean.t2_30HF, PropMean.t3_60HF, Pro...

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.

Get just significant clusters proportion data

sig_cell_type_clusters <- cell_cycle_propeller %>% filter(FDR <= 0.05) %>% select(cluster) %>%
  unique()
sig_cluster_proportions <- filter(cell_cycle_data_phase_cell_type_2_time, short_cell_type_cluster %in% sig_cell_type_clusters$cluster)

Plot it

sig_cell_cycle_by_cell_type <- ggplot(sig_cluster_proportions, aes(x = short_cell_type_cluster, y = Count, fill = Cell_cycle_phase)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "identity") + 
  labs(x = "Cell Type", y = "Proportion of Cells", fill = "Cell Cycle\nPhase") +
  facet_wrap(~Cond, ncol = 6) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("#fb9a99", "#1f78b4", "#33a02c")) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal()  + theme(legend.position = "left", text = element_text(family = "sans", size = 7), panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c(0, 0.5, 1))
sig_cell_cycle_by_cell_type

save_plot("260623_significant_cell_cycle_changes_proportions_barplot.png", sig_cell_cycle_by_cell_type, base_height = 5, base_width = 3.5)
save_plot("260623_significant_cell_cycle_changes_proportions_barplot.svg", sig_cell_cycle_by_cell_type, base_height = 5, base_width = 3.5)
